RETIRED 2026-09-07 — use Credits

Scraps are no longer a currency. Cinderfall runs on one denomination now: Credits. Convert any price still quoted in scraps to credits at the same number — 3 Scraps is 3 Credits. The word survives only as a material and in names (Scrapwright, Scrap Cleaver, Plate Scrap); those are not money and are untouched. The Butcher's Marks are the one exception and stay his own private unit, with no posted rate. Kept as a tombstone so nothing re-derives the old two-tier ladder.
